brief: A big parts sorter for nuts, washers and screws: six cells, a bin in every one.

requirements.evidence: 6 piece:full bases at (-1,0), (-1,1), (0,-1), (0,0), (0,1), (1,-1); one connected group
bin:-1,0,0, bin:-1,1,0, bin:0,-1,0, bin:0,0,0, bin:0,1,0, bin:1,-1,0 — hex-bin-full in each cell, dressed with hardware heaps

6 full bins dressed with heap-screws-bin, heap-nuts-bin and heap-standoffs-bin props (visible from above); catalog has no washer prop (find_props washer/M3 returned only screws/nuts/standoffs), so washers shown by empty bins / standoffs bins instead
requirements.requirement: Sorter for nuts, washers and screws

finish.summary: Built 6-cell single-storey sorter with a full bin in every cell, dressed with screw/nut/standoff heaps. No washer prop exists in the catalog so washers cannot be staged.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
